serp_refs: Marketplace scan: composition notebook classroom rugs use custom teacher name, learning area, daycare, play rug, welcome and back-to-school modifiers.
Marketplace scan: octopus rugs and mats use coastal, nautical, beach, ocean, sea life, entryway, bathroom, living room and memory foam/non slip terms.
Marketplace scan: golf rugs use golf area rug, golf decor, boys bedroom, office, man cave, front door and non slip wording.
keyword_evidence: Use visual-specific long tails: adventure classroom rug, composition notebook play rug, blue octopus rug, coastal octopus area rug, ocean octopus rug, floral octopus rug, golf area rug and golf decor rug.
buyer_summary: B056 buyers include teachers looking for personalized classroom rugs, coastal decor shoppers choosing octopus sea-life rugs, and golf fans buying themed room or entry decor. They care about visible theme accuracy, room placement, size options, soft memory foam/microfiber feel and anti slip backing.
purchase_concerns: Do not call all octopus items welcome mats when evidence shows area rug room mockups. Keep golf rugs decor-focused rather than sport equipment. For classroom rugs, separate adventure map and composition book welcome designs.
